title: fix(gemini): map the sync response usageMetadata to the OpenAI usage shape

files.patch:
@@ -33,6 +33,20 @@ def _completion_tokens(usage_meta: dict) -> int:
     return (usage_meta.get("candidatesTokenCount") or 0) + (usage_meta.get("thoughtsTokenCount") or 0)
 
 
+def _openai_usage(usage_meta) -> dict:
+    """Map a Gemini usageMetadata to the OpenAI usage shape the agent reads.
+
+    Returns {} when Gemini reported none, so the caller falls back to estimating.
+    """
+    if not isinstance(usage_meta, dict) or not usage_meta:
+        return {}
+    return {
+        "prompt_tokens": usage_meta.get("promptTokenCount", 0),
+        "completion_tokens": _completion_tokens(usage_meta),
+        "total_tokens": usage_meta.get("totalTokenCount", 0),
+    }
+
+
 # OpenAI对话模型API (可用)
 class GoogleGeminiBot(Bot):
 
@@ -675,7 +689,7 @@ def _handle_gemini_rest_sync_response(self, response, model_name):
                     "message": message_dict,
                     "finish_reason": "tool_calls" if tool_calls else "stop"
                 }],
-                "usage": data.get("usageMetadata", {}),
+                "usage": _openai_usage(data.get("usageMetadata")),
                 "safety_ratings": safety_ratings
             }

@@ -70,3 +70,28 @@ def test_missing_thinking_tokens_leave_the_answer_count_unchanged():
 
     assert _completion_tokens({"candidatesTokenCount": 10}) == 10
     assert _completion_tokens({}) == 0
+
+
+class _SyncResponse:
+    status_code = 200
+    text = ""
+
+    def __init__(self, usage):
+        self._body = {"candidates": [{"content": {"parts": [{"text": "hi"}]}, "finishReason": "STOP"}]}
+        if usage is not None:
+            self._body["usageMetadata"] = usage
+
+    def json(self):
+        return self._body
+
+
+def test_sync_response_maps_usage_to_the_openai_shape():
+    result = _bot()._handle_gemini_rest_sync_response(_SyncResponse(USAGE), "gemini-2.5-flash")
+
+    assert result["usage"] == {"prompt_tokens": 31, "completion_tokens": 50, "total_tokens": 81}
+
+
+def test_sync_response_without_usage_metadata_keeps_the_usage_empty():
+    result = _bot()._handle_gemini_rest_sync_response(_SyncResponse(None), "gemini-2.5-flash")
+
+    assert result["usage"] == {}
